SELECT /* selectExportExOlExportProgressPoList */ POHD.PKG_COMPANY_CODE, PODT.BUYER, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = PODT.BUYER) AS BUYER_NAME, POHD.AGENT, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = POHD.AGENT) AS AGENT_NAME, CASE WHEN CIHD.COMPLETE_MARK = 'Y' THEN '납품완료' ELSE CASE WHEN CIHD.BL_COMPLETE_MARK = 'Y' THEN 'B/L생성' ELSE CASE WHEN IVDT.PKG_GR_QTY > 0 AND CIHD.CI_NO IS NOT NULL THEN 'C/I, P/L생성' ELSE '입고등록' END END END AS STATUS, PODT.PO_NO, PODT.PO_SEQ, PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO, PODT.LEGACY_PO_SEQ, IVDT.INV_NO, IVDT.INV_SEQ, PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO, (SELECT HS_CODE FROM ICOMBYIT WHERE BUYER = PODT.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO) AS HS_CODE, PRDT.EXP_FOR_UNIT_PRICE, PRDT.EXP_FOR_ITEM_AMT, PODT.DESCRIPTION, PODT.SPECIFICATION, CIDT.CI_NO, CIDT.CI_SEQ, CIHD.CI_DATE, BLDT.BL_NO, CIHD.FORWARDER, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'EP01' AND CODE = CIHD.FORWARDER) AS FORWARDER_NAME, CIHD.SHIP_METHOD, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'EP02' AND CODE = CIHD.SHIP_METHOD) AS SHIP_METHOD_NAME, CIHD.CURRENCY_CODE, PODT.ITEM_QTY AS PO_ITEM_QTY, IVDT.INV_QTY AS IV_ITEM_QTY, CIDT.INV_QTY, CIDT.NET_WEIGHT, CIDT.GROSS_WEIGHT, CIDT.CBM, CIDT.CTN_NO_FROM, CIDT.CTN_NO_TO, 6 AS CI_SHEET, 6 AS PL_SHEET, BLHD.IMAGE_KEY AS BL_IMAGE_KEY, DECODE(BLHD.IMAGE_KEY, '', 3, 2) AS BL_IMAGE_KEY_IMG, DECODE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KEP_EXP_LOT_INFO WHERE PKG_COMPANY_CODE = CIDT.PKG_COMPANY_CODE AND BUYER = CIDT.BUYER AND CI_NO = CIDT.CI_NO AND CI_SEQ = CIDT.CI_SEQ AND STATUS IN ('C', 'R')), 0, 4, 5) AS LOT_IMG, CIHD.EXP_REPORT_DATE, CIHD.EXP_SHIP_DATE, CIHD.ENTRY_EXCHANGE_RATE, CIHD.IMAGE_KEY AS CI_IMAGE_KEY, DECODE(CIHD.IMAGE_KEY, '', 3, 2) AS CI_IMAGE_KEY_IMG ,(SELECT MSDS_NO FROM ICOMBYIT BYIT WHERE BYIT.BUYER = PODT.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AND BYIT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO) AS MSDS_NO, COD2.TEXT1 AS PURCHASE_DEPT FROM ICOMPODT PODT, ICOMPOHD POHD, ICOMPRDT PRDT, ICOMIVDT IVDT, KEP_EXP_CIDT CIDT, KEP_EXP_CIHD CIHD, KEP_EXP_BLDT BLDT, KEP_EXP_BLHD BLHD, ICOMCOD2 COD2 WHERE 1=1 AND PODT.BUYER = POHD.BUYER AND PODT.PO_NO = POHD.PO_NO AND PODT.BUYER = PRDT.BUYER AND PODT.PR_NO = PRDT.PR_NO AND PODT.PR_SEQ = PRDT.PR_SEQ AND PODT.BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND PODT.PO_NO = IVDT.PO_NO AND PODT.PO_SEQ = IVDT.PO_SEQ AND PRDT.BUYER = COD2.COMPANY_CODE(+) AND COD2.TYPE(+) = 'C001' AND PRDT.PURCHASER_DEPT = COD2.CODE(+) AND POHD.STATUS <> 'D' AND PODT.STATUS <> 'D' AND PRDT.STATUS <> 'D' AND IVDT.STATUS <> 'D' AND PRDT.EXP_CUR IS NOT NULL AND IVDT.BUYER = CIDT.BUYER AND IVDT.INV_NO = CIDT.INV_NO AND IVDT.INV_SEQ = CIDT.INV_SEQ AND CIDT.PKG_COMPANY_CODE = CIHD.PKG_COMPANY_CODE AND CIDT.BUYER = CIHD.BUYER AND CIDT.CI_NO = CIHD.CI_NO AND CIDT.STATUS <> 'D' AND CIHD.STATUS <> 'D' AND CIDT.PKG_COMPANY_CODE = BLDT.PKG_COMPANY_CODE(+) AND CIDT.BUYER = BLDT.BUYER(+) AND CIDT.CI_NO = BLDT.CI_NO(+) AND BLDT.PKG_COMPANY_CODE = BLHD.PKG_COMPANY_CODE(+) AND BLDT.BUYER = BLHD.BUYER(+) AND BLDT.BL_NO = BLHD.BL_NO(+)
AND POHD.PKG_COMPANY_CODE = #{st_pkg_cmpy_no} AND PODT.PROCESS_TYPE = '0'
AND CIHD.CI_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date}
AND PODT.BUYER IN
#{item}
AND POHD.AGENT = #{st_agent_code}
AND CIDT.CI_NO LIKE #{st_ci_no} || '%'
AND BLDT.BL_NO LIKE #{st_bl_no} || '%'
AND PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE #{st_buyer_item_no} || '%'
AND IVDT.INV_NO LIKE #{st_inv_no} || '%'
AND UPPER(COD2.TEXT1) LIKE UPPER('%'||#{st_purchase_dept}||'%')
AND PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO LIKE #{st_legacy_po_no} || '%'
AND PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO = #{st_legacy_po_no}
AND PODT.PO_NO LIKE #{st_po_no} || '%'
AND PODT.PO_NO = #{st_po_no}
AND IVDT.PKG_GR_QTY > 0 AND CIHD.CI_NO IS NULL
AND CIHD.CI_NO IS NOT NULL AND BLDT.BL_NO IS NULL
AND CIHD.BL_COMPLETE_MARK = 'Y' AND CIHD.COMPLETE_MARK = 'N'
AND CIHD.COMPLETE_MARK = 'Y'
UNION ALL
SELECT POHD.PKG_COMPANY_CODE, PODT.BUYER, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = PODT.BUYER) AS BUYER_NAME, POHD.AGENT, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = POHD.AGENT) AS AGENT_NAME, CASE WHEN CIHD.COMPLETE_MARK = 'Y' THEN '납품완료' ELSE CASE WHEN CIHD.BL_COMPLETE_MARK = 'Y' THEN 'B/L생성' ELSE CASE WHEN IVDT.PKG_GR_QTY > 0 AND CIHD.CI_NO IS NOT NULL THEN 'C/I, P/L생성' ELSE '입고등록' END END END AS STATUS, PODT.PO_NO, PODT.PO_SEQ, PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO, PODT.LEGACY_PO_SEQ, IVDT.INV_NO, IVDT.INV_SEQ, PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO, (SELECT HS_CODE FROM ICOMBYIT WHERE BUYER = PODT.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO) AS HS_CODE, PRDT.EXP_FOR_UNIT_PRICE, PRDT.EXP_FOR_ITEM_AMT, PODT.DESCRIPTION, PODT.SPECIFICATION, CIDT.CI_NO, CIDT.CI_SEQ, CIHD.CI_DATE, BLDT.BL_NO, CIHD.FORWARDER, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'EP01' AND CODE = CIHD.FORWARDER) AS FORWARDER_NAME, CIHD.SHIP_METHOD, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'EP02' AND CODE = CIHD.SHIP_METHOD) AS SHIP_METHOD_NAME, CIHD.CURRENCY_CODE, PODT.ITEM_QTY AS PO_ITEM_QTY, IVDT.INV_QTY AS IV_ITEM_QTY, CIDT.INV_QTY, CIDT.NET_WEIGHT, CIDT.GROSS_WEIGHT, CIDT.CBM, CIDT.CTN_NO_FROM, CIDT.CTN_NO_TO, 6 AS CI_SHEET, 6 AS PL_SHEET, BLHD.IMAGE_KEY AS BL_IMAGE_KEY, DECODE(BLHD.IMAGE_KEY, '', 3, 2) AS BL_IMAGE_KEY_IMG, DECODE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KEP_EXP_LOT_INFO WHERE PKG_COMPANY_CODE = CIDT.PKG_COMPANY_CODE AND BUYER = CIDT.BUYER AND CI_NO = CIDT.CI_NO AND CI_SEQ = CIDT.CI_SEQ AND STATUS IN ('C', 'R')), 0, 4, 5) AS LOT_IMG, CIHD.EXP_REPORT_DATE, CIHD.EXP_SHIP_DATE, CIHD.ENTRY_EXCHANGE_RATE, CIHD.IMAGE_KEY AS CI_IMAGE_KEY, DECODE(CIHD.IMAGE_KEY, '', 3, 2) AS CI_IMAGE_KEY_IMG ,(SELECT MSDS_NO FROM ICOMBYIT BYIT WHERE BYIT.BUYER = PODT.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AND BYIT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO) AS MSDS_NO, COD2.TEXT1 AS PURCHASE_DEPT FROM ICOMPODT PODT, ICOMPOHD POHD, ICOMPRDT PRDT, WMSIVDT IVDT, KEP_EXP_CIDT CIDT, KEP_EXP_CIHD CIHD, KEP_EXP_BLDT BLDT, KEP_EXP_BLHD BLHD, ICOMCOD2 COD2 WHERE 1=1 AND PODT.BUYER = POHD.BUYER AND PODT.PO_NO = POHD.PO_NO AND PODT.BUYER = PRDT.BUYER AND PODT.PR_NO = PRDT.PR_NO AND PODT.PR_SEQ = PRDT.PR_SEQ AND PODT.BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND PODT.PO_NO = IVDT.PO_NO AND PODT.PO_SEQ = IVDT.PO_SEQ AND PRDT.BUYER = COD2.COMPANY_CODE(+) AND COD2.TYPE(+) = 'C001' AND PRDT.PURCHASER_DEPT = COD2.CODE(+) AND POHD.STATUS <> 'D' AND PODT.STATUS <> 'D' AND PRDT.STATUS <> 'D' AND IVDT.STATUS <> 'D' AND PRDT.EXP_CUR IS NOT NULL AND IVDT.BUYER = CIDT.BUYER AND IVDT.INV_NO = CIDT.INV_NO AND IVDT.INV_SEQ = CIDT.INV_SEQ AND CIDT.PKG_COMPANY_CODE = CIHD.PKG_COMPANY_CODE AND CIDT.BUYER = CIHD.BUYER AND CIDT.CI_NO = CIHD.CI_NO AND CIDT.STATUS <> 'D' AND CIHD.STATUS <> 'D' AND CIDT.PKG_COMPANY_CODE = BLDT.PKG_COMPANY_CODE(+) AND CIDT.BUYER = BLDT.BUYER(+) AND CIDT.CI_NO = BLDT.CI_NO(+) AND BLDT.PKG_COMPANY_CODE = BLHD.PKG_COMPANY_CODE(+) AND BLDT.BUYER = BLHD.BUYER(+) AND BLDT.BL_NO = BLHD.BL_NO(+)
AND POHD.PKG_COMPANY_CODE = #{st_pkg_cmpy_no} AND PODT.PROCESS_TYPE <> '0'
AND CIHD.CI_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date}
AND PODT.BUYER IN
#{item}
AND POHD.AGENT = #{st_agent_code}
AND CIDT.CI_NO LIKE #{st_ci_no} || '%'
AND BLDT.BL_NO LIKE #{st_bl_no} || '%'
AND PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE #{st_buyer_item_no} || '%'
AND IVDT.INV_NO LIKE #{st_inv_no} || '%'
AND UPPER(COD2.TEXT1) LIKE UPPER('%'||#{st_purchase_dept}||'%')
AND PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO LIKE #{st_legacy_po_no} || '%'
AND PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO = #{st_legacy_po_no}
AND PODT.PO_NO LIKE #{st_po_no} || '%'
AND PODT.PO_NO = #{st_po_no}
AND IVDT.PKG_GR_QTY > 0 AND CIHD.CI_NO IS NULL
AND CIHD.CI_NO IS NOT NULL AND BLDT.BL_NO IS NULL
AND CIHD.BL_COMPLETE_MARK = 'Y' AND CIHD.COMPLETE_MARK = 'N'
AND CIHD.COMPLETE_MARK = 'Y'
ORDER BY PKG_COMPANY_CODE, BUYER, PO_NO, PO_SEQ
